blocks.en: Appendices 6-7: References and Glossary of Terms

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Chapter

blocks.zh: 掌握 SUT 領域的完整參考標準體系，理解 ICH、ISO、USP、EP、ASTM、BPSA、BPOG 等組織在一次性技術法規框架中的定位與權重
blocks.en: Understand the complete body of reference standards in the SUT field, and the positioning and weight of organizations such as ICH, ISO, USP, EP, ASTM, BPSA and BPOG within the regulatory framework for single-use technology

blocks.zh: 熟悉 SUT 專業縮寫與首字母縮略詞，建立與製造商、供應商及法規機構溝通的共同語言基礎
blocks.en: Become familiar with SUT-specific abbreviations and acronyms, building a common language for communicating with manufacturers, suppliers and regulators

blocks.zh: 理解 Extractables & Leachables、Single-Use System、Container Closure System、Functionally Closed Process 等關鍵術語的正式定義及在實務中的應用界限
blocks.en: Understand the formal definitions of key terms such as Extractables & Leachables, Single-Use System, Container Closure System and Functionally Closed Process, and the limits of their application in practice

blocks.zh: 能夠依據標準體系快速定位特定技術要求的原始出處，支援供應商審計、法規申報及內部風險評估
blocks.en: Be able to locate the original source of a specific technical requirement quickly from the standards system, supporting vendor audits, regulatory submissions and internal risk assessments

blocks.zh: Appendix 6 – References（附錄6 – 參考文獻）
blocks.en: Appendix 6 – References

blocks.zh: Part A：組織機構與法規文件（Refs 1–30）
blocks.en: Part A: Organizations and Regulatory Documents (Refs 1–30)

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SUT 參考標準體系的五大支柱
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Five Pillars of SUT Reference Standards

blocks.zh: 本附錄的 129 項參考文獻可歸納為五大類，構成一次性技術的完整法規架構：
blocks.en: The 129 references in this appendix can be grouped into five categories, which together make up the complete regulatory architecture for single-use technology:

blocks.zh: 行業組織（Industry Bodies）：BPSA、BPOG、PDA — 制定行業最佳實務指引，尤其在 E&L 測試和標準化方面
blocks.en: Industry bodies: BPSA, BPOG, PDA - develop industry best-practice guidance, especially on E&L testing and standardization

blocks.zh: 法規文件（Regulatory）：FDA Aseptic Guidance（2004）、EU Annex 1、ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 — 法規合規的法源依據
blocks.en: Regulatory documents: FDA Aseptic Guidance (2004), EU Annex 1, ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 - the legal basis for regulatory compliance

blocks.zh: 藥典（Pharmacopoeia）：USP、EP、JP — 材料測試方法和接受標準的技術規範
blocks.en: Pharmacopoeias: USP, EP, JP - technical specifications for material test methods and acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: 國際標準（ISO/ASTM）：ISO 10993（生物相容性）、ISO 11137（輻射滅菌）、ASTM 系列 — 測試方法與驗收標準
blocks.en: International standards (ISO/ASTM): ISO 10993 (biocompatibility), ISO 11137 (radiation sterilization), the ASTM series - test methods and acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: ISPE 出版物：Baseline Guides（Vol.1-6）、GAMP 5、GEP Guide — 藥廠工程的專業指引
blocks.en: ISPE publications: Baseline Guides (Vol. 1–6), GAMP 5, the GEP Guide - professional guidance for pharmaceutical engineering

blocks.zh: BPSA vs. BPOG：兩大 SUT 行業組織的定位
blocks.en: BPSA vs. BPOG: The Positioning of the Two Major SUT Industry Bodies

blocks.zh: BPSA（Bio-Process Systems Alliance）是一次性設備製造商的聯盟，其技術指引代表供應商的立場，涵蓋粒子測試、廢棄物處置等議題。
blocks.en: BPSA (Bio-Process Systems Alliance) is an alliance of single-use equipment manufacturers. Its technical guides represent the supplier's perspective and cover topics such as particulate testing and waste disposal.

blocks.zh: BPOG（BioPhorum Operations Group）則是生物製藥廠商（終端使用者）的協作聯盟，其指引更聚焦於 E&L 風險評估、供應商管理和變更通知等使用者關切的議題。
blocks.en: BPOG (BioPhorum Operations Group) is a collaborative alliance of biopharmaceutical manufacturers (the end-users). Its guides focus more on issues of concern to users, such as E&L risk assessment, supplier management and change notification.

blocks.zh: 兩者合作發布的「BPOG/BPSA Industry Proposal for Change Notification Practices」（Ref.81）是業界重要的共識文件。
blocks.en: The "BPOG/BPSA Industry Proposal for Change Notification Practices" (Ref. 81), published jointly by the two, is an important industry consensus document.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：ICH 三劍客在 SUT 中的應用
blocks.en: Key Point: How the ICH Trio Applies to SUT

blocks.zh: ICH Q8(R2) 藥品開發：支援 SUT 的 QbD 導入，特別是相容性和 E&L 測試的設計空間定義
blocks.en: ICH Q8(R2) Pharmaceutical Development: supports the introduction of QbD for SUT, especially defining the design space for compatibility and E&L testing

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 風險管理：SUT 風險評估（如 FMEA）的核心框架，貫穿整本指引
blocks.en: ICH Q9 Risk Management: the core framework for SUT risk assessment (such as FMEA), referenced throughout the whole guide

blocks.zh: ICH Q3D 元素雜質：金屬溶出物測試的管理依據，一次性袋子的金屬殘留是 E&L 審查重點
blocks.en: ICH Q3D Elemental Impurities: the governing basis for metal leachables testing; metal residues from single-use bags are a focus of E&L review

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把 SUT 的法規標準體系想像成一座金字塔：頂層是 FDA/EU GMP（法律強制性最高），中層是 ICH 指引和 ISO 標準（國際共識），底層是 BPSA/BPOG 行業指引（自願性最佳實務）。在向法規機構申報時，三個層次都需要引用，但金字塔越頂層的文件，其法律分量越重。
blocks.en: Think of the SUT regulatory standards system as a pyramid: the top layer is FDA/EU GMP (legally the most binding), the middle layer is ICH guidelines and ISO standards (international consensus), and the base layer is the BPSA/BPOG industry guidance (voluntary best practice). All three layers need to be cited in a regulatory submission, but the higher up the pyramid, the greater the legal weight of the document.

blocks.zh: 藥典三巨頭：USP、EP、JP 在 SUT 的角色
blocks.en: The Three Pharmacopoeias: The Roles of USP, EP and JP in SUT

blocks.zh: USP（美國藥典）：<87>/<88> 生物相容性測試、<661> 塑膠包裝系統、<85> 細菌內毒素測試 — 美國法規申報的標準參照
blocks.en: USP (United States Pharmacopeia): <87>/<88> biological reactivity tests, <661> plastic packaging systems, <85> bacterial endotoxins test - the standard reference for US regulatory submissions

blocks.zh: EP（歐洲藥典）：3.1.x 系列（聚乙烯、聚丙烯等）、2.6.14 細菌內毒素、3.2.9 橡膠閉合件 — 歐盟市場的材料規範
blocks.en: EP (European Pharmacopoeia): the 3.1.x series (polyethylene, polypropylene, etc.), 2.6.14 bacterial endotoxins, 3.2.9 rubber closures - material specifications for the EU market

blocks.zh: JP（日本藥局方）：Section 7.03 橡膠閉合件測試 — 日本市場申報時需符合
blocks.en: JP (Japanese Pharmacopoeia): Section 7.03 test for rubber closure - must be met for submissions to the Japanese market

blocks.zh: 多地區同步申報時，需同時滿足三份藥典的要求，這是選材和測試計劃設計時的複雜挑戰。
blocks.en: For simultaneous multi-region submissions, the requirements of all three pharmacopoeias must be met together, which is a complex challenge when designing the material selection and test plan.

blocks.zh: Part B：技術測試標準（Refs 31–70）
blocks.en: Part B: Technical Test Standards (Refs 31–70)

blocks.zh: E&L 測試的標準化里程碑
blocks.en: Milestones in the Standardization of E&L Testing

blocks.zh: Ref.31（Ding et al., 2014）是一次性系統 E&L 標準化測試協議的里程碑文章，由多個主要製藥公司（Amgen、Biogen 等）合作制定，奠定了行業共識的測試方法，至今仍是 E&L 研究的核心參考文獻。
blocks.en: Ref. 31 (Ding et al., 2014) is a landmark paper on a standardized E&L test protocol for single-use systems. It was developed jointly by several major pharmaceutical companies (Amgen, Biogen, etc.), established the industry consensus on test methods, and remains a core reference for E&L studies today.

blocks.zh: Ref.70（Hammond et al., 2013）則提供了著名的 DMPP（一次性容器中的有害浸出化合物）案例，說明為何 E&L 評估必須包括細胞毒性測試，不能僅依靠化學分析。
blocks.en: Ref. 70 (Hammond et al., 2013) presents the well-known DMPP case (a harmful leachable compound from single-use containers), showing why an E&L assessment must include cytotoxicity testing and cannot rely on chemical analysis alone.

blocks.zh: ASTM E3051 vs. E2500：SUT 專屬標準
blocks.en: ASTM E3051 vs. E2500: An SUT-Specific Standard

blocks.zh: ASTM E2500（Ref.40）是藥廠設備確認的通用標準，適用於所有製藥製造系統。
blocks.en: ASTM E2500 (Ref. 40) is the general standard for specification, design and verification of pharmaceutical manufacturing systems and equipment, applicable to all pharmaceutical manufacturing systems.

blocks.zh: ASTM E3051（Ref.41）則是 2016 年專門針對一次性系統制定的標準，明確規定了 SUS 的規格制定、設計、驗證和應用指南，是業界首個 SUT 專屬的 ASTM 標準。
blocks.en: ASTM E3051 (Ref. 41) is a 2016 standard written specifically for single-use systems. It explicitly covers guidance on the specification, design, verification and application of SUS, and is the first ASTM standard dedicated to SUT in the industry.

blocks.zh: 在進行 SUT 供應商審計或系統確認時，E3051 是更直接相關的引用文件。
blocks.en: When auditing an SUT supplier or qualifying a system, E3051 is the more directly relevant reference document.

blocks.zh: 輻射滅菌標準：ISO 11137 的重要性
blocks.en: Radiation Sterilization Standard: The Importance of ISO 11137

blocks.zh: Ref.51（ANSI/AAMI/ISO 11137-1）是一次性系統伽瑪滅菌驗證的核心標準，涵蓋滅菌劑量設定、劑量分布驗證和日常控制要求。SUT 供應商的一次性組件通常以伽瑪輻射預先滅菌交貨，因此此標準在供應商審計和滅菌確認時至關重要。
blocks.en: Ref. 51 (ANSI/AAMI/ISO 11137-1) is the core standard for gamma sterilization validation of single-use systems, covering sterilization dose setting, dose distribution verification and routine control requirements. Single-use components from SUT suppliers are usually delivered pre-sterilized by gamma irradiation, so this standard is critical in supplier audits and sterilization qualification.

blocks.zh: 粒子控制的法規體系
blocks.en: The Regulatory Framework for Particulate Control

blocks.zh: 注射劑粒子控制跨越多個層次的法規文件，需要同時符合：
blocks.en: Particulate control for injectables spans several levels of regulatory documents, and all of them must be met:

blocks.zh: USP <788>（Ref.49）：次可見粒子（Sub-visible）的數量限制
blocks.en: USP <788> (Ref. 49): numerical limits for sub-visible particles

blocks.zh: USP <790>（Ref.67）：可見粒子（Visible）的目視檢查
blocks.en: USP <790> (Ref. 67): visual inspection for visible particles

blocks.zh: EP 2.9.19：次可見粒子（歐洲藥典版本）
blocks.en: EP 2.9.19: sub-visible particles (European Pharmacopoeia version)

blocks.zh: EP 2.9.20：可見粒子（歐洲藥典版本）
blocks.en: EP 2.9.20: visible particles (European Pharmacopoeia version)

blocks.zh: BPSA 2014 粒子指引（Ref.50）：SUT 組件特有的粒子來源識別與控制建議
blocks.en: BPSA 2014 particulate guide (Ref. 50): recommendations for identifying and controlling the particulate sources specific to SUT components

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：ISO/IEC 17025 為何重要
blocks.en: Analogy: Why ISO/IEC 17025 Matters

blocks.zh: Ref.38（ISO/IEC 17025）是實驗室能力認證的國際標準。想像這是一張「實驗室執照」— 就像醫師執照確認醫師具備行醫能力，ISO 17025 認證確認實驗室的測試結果是可信、可重複且可比較的。當你要求 SUT 供應商提供 E&L 測試報告時，確認實驗室是否具備 ISO 17025 認證，是評估數據可靠性的第一步。
blocks.en: Ref. 38 (ISO/IEC 17025) is the international standard for laboratory competence accreditation. Think of it as a "laboratory license": just as a medical license confirms that a physician is competent to practice, ISO 17025 accreditation confirms that a laboratory's test results are reliable, repeatable and comparable. When you ask an SUT supplier for an E&L test report, checking whether the laboratory holds ISO 17025 accreditation is the first step in judging the reliability of the data.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 在委託 SUT 供應商進行 E&L 測試時，你應要求供應商引用哪些標準？Ref.31 的標準化協議和 BPOG 指引（Ref.71）各在測試計劃中扮演什麼角色？
blocks.en: When commissioning an SUT supplier to perform E&L testing, which standards should you require the supplier to cite? What roles do the standardized protocol of Ref. 31 and the BPOG guide (Ref. 71) each play in the test plan?

blocks.zh: ASTM E3051（Ref.41）與 ASTM E2500（Ref.40）在應用範圍上有何差異？在一次性生物反應器的確認文件中，應引用哪個標準？
blocks.en: How do ASTM E3051 (Ref. 41) and ASTM E2500 (Ref. 40) differ in scope of application? Which standard should be cited in the qualification documents for a single-use bioreactor?

blocks.zh: Part C：材料、包裝完整性與環保標準（Refs 71–129）
blocks.en: Part C: Materials, Package Integrity and Environmental Standards (Refs 71–129)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：USP <665> 的戰略重要性
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Strategic Importance of USP <665>

blocks.zh: USP <665>（Ref.66，涵蓋 SUT 組件的聚合物材料測試）是本指引中最具前瞻性的藥典引用。此章節專門針對生物製藥製造中使用的聚合物組件，涵蓋 E&L 分析的完整測試框架，填補了傳統包裝藥典章節（<661>、<661.1>）無法完整涵蓋 SUT 情境的空白。
blocks.en: USP <665> (Ref. 66, covering polymeric materials for SUT components) is the most forward-looking pharmacopoeial reference in this guide. This chapter is aimed specifically at polymeric components used in biopharmaceutical manufacturing and covers a complete test framework for E&L analysis, filling the gap that the traditional packaging pharmacopoeial chapters (<661>, <661.1>) cannot fully cover for SUT scenarios.

blocks.zh: TSE/BSE 管控的法規體系
blocks.en: The Regulatory Framework for TSE/BSE Control

blocks.zh: 對於使用動物源材料的 SUT 組件（如橡膠塞中的動物源添加劑），TSE 風險管控需要同時符合：
blocks.en: For SUT components that use animal-derived materials (such as animal-derived additives in rubber stoppers), TSE risk control must satisfy all of the following:

blocks.zh: EU 97/534/EC（Ref.27）：動物源材料的禁止使用規定
blocks.en: EU 97/534/EC (Ref. 27): prohibition on the use of certain animal-derived materials

blocks.zh: EP 5.2.8（Ref.94）：最小化 TSE 傳播風險的歐洲藥典要求
blocks.en: EP 5.2.8 (Ref. 94): European Pharmacopoeia requirements for minimizing the risk of TSE transmission

blocks.zh: EMA/410/01 rev.3（Ref.95）：EMA 的具體 TSE 指引
blocks.en: EMA/410/01 rev.3 (Ref. 95): the EMA's specific TSE guidance

blocks.zh: 9 CFR Part 94（Ref.93）：美國 USDA 對動物疾病傳播的進口管制
blocks.en: 9 CFR Part 94 (Ref. 93): USDA import controls to prevent the spread of animal disease in the US

blocks.zh: 供應商的 TSE/BSE 合規聲明文件（CoC）是供應商審計的必查項目。
blocks.en: The supplier's TSE/BSE compliance statement (CoC) is a must-check item in a supplier audit.

blocks.zh: 包裝完整性測試的多元方法
blocks.en: A Range of Methods for Package Integrity Testing

blocks.zh: Refs 111–120 提供了針對 SUT 密封完整性測試的完整 ASTM 標準矩陣：
blocks.en: Refs 111–120 provide a complete matrix of ASTM standards for seal integrity testing of SUT:

blocks.zh: ASTM F2338（Ref.112）：真空衰減法（非破壞性，最常用）
blocks.en: ASTM F2338 (Ref. 112): vacuum decay method (non-destructive, most commonly used)

blocks.zh: ASTM F88（Ref.113）：密封強度測試（破壞性）
blocks.en: ASTM F88 (Ref. 113): seal strength test (destructive)

blocks.zh: ASTM F1929（Ref.115）：染料穿透法（視覺確認）
blocks.en: ASTM F1929 (Ref. 115): dye penetration method (visual confirmation)

blocks.zh: ASTM E498/E499（Refs.116–117）：質譜儀洩漏偵測（最靈敏）
blocks.en: ASTM E498/E499 (Refs. 116–117): mass spectrometer leak detection (most sensitive)

blocks.zh: ASTM E432（Ref.120）：洩漏測試方法選擇指引（決策樹工具）
blocks.en: ASTM E432 (Ref. 120): guide for selecting a leak test method (a decision-tree tool)

blocks.zh: 根據 USP <1207>（Ref.63），完整性測試方法的選擇應基於風險評估，優先使用確定性（Deterministic）方法如真空衰減法，而非機率性（Probabilistic）方法如微生物挑戰。
blocks.en: According to USP <1207> (Ref. 63), the choice of integrity test method should be based on risk assessment, preferring deterministic methods such as vacuum decay over probabilistic methods such as the microbial challenge.

blocks.zh: BPOG/BPSA 變更通知的行業共識
blocks.en: The Industry Consensus on BPOG/BPSA Change Notification

blocks.zh: Ref.81（BPOG/BPSA Change Notification Proposal）解決了 SUT 使用者最頭痛的問題：供應商變更原料或製程時，如何及時通知下游客戶？這份文件建立了「主動變更通知」的行業標準，要求供應商在生效日前 12 個月通知客戶重大變更，讓製藥廠有時間評估影響並更新法規申報文件。
blocks.en: Ref. 81 (BPOG/BPSA Change Notification Proposal) addresses the biggest headache for SUT users: when a supplier changes a raw material or process, how can downstream customers be notified in time? This document sets an industry standard of "proactive change notification", requiring suppliers to notify customers of major changes 12 months before the effective date, giving drug manufacturers time to assess the impact and update their regulatory filings.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 情境：你的一次性儲液袋供應商通知材料規格有微幅變更。你需要決定是否影響現有法規申報。應引用哪些標準進行評估？
blocks.en: Scenario: the supplier of your single-use storage bags notifies you of a minor change in material specification. You need to decide whether it affects existing regulatory filings. Which standards should you cite for the assessment?

blocks.zh: 建議評估架構：
blocks.en: Suggested assessment framework:

blocks.zh: 變更管理依據：ICH Q10（Ref.42）+ ISPE PQLI Part 3（Ref.80）
blocks.en: Change management basis: ICH Q10 (Ref. 42) + ISPE PQLI Part 3 (Ref. 80)

blocks.zh: E&L 影響評估：BPOG 指引（Ref.71）+ Ref.31 標準化協議
blocks.en: E&L impact assessment: BPOG guide (Ref. 71) + the standardized protocol of Ref. 31

blocks.zh: 材料相容性測試：USP <661.1>（Ref.64）+ EP 3.1.x 系列（Refs.73, 89–92）
blocks.en: Material compatibility testing: USP <661.1> (Ref. 64) + the EP 3.1.x series (Refs. 73, 89–92)

blocks.zh: 完整性確認：USP <1207>（Ref.63）+ ASTM F2338（Ref.112）
blocks.en: Integrity confirmation: USP <1207> (Ref. 63) + ASTM F2338 (Ref. 112)

blocks.zh: 申報變更判斷：21 CFR Part 820.100（Ref.123）+ ICH Q6B（Ref.124）
blocks.en: Judging whether the change is reportable: 21 CFR Part 820.100 (Ref. 123) + ICH Q6B (Ref. 124)

blocks.zh: Appendix 7 – Glossary（附錄7 – 術語詞彙）
blocks.en: Appendix 7 – Glossary

blocks.zh: 7.1 Acronyms and Abbreviations（縮寫與首字母縮略詞）
blocks.en: 7.1 Acronyms and Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SUT 縮寫的功能性分類
blocks.en: Core Concept: A Functional Classification of SUT Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 這些縮寫可按功能分為幾大群組，幫助快速定位：
blocks.en: These abbreviations can be divided by function into several groups to help you locate them quickly:

blocks.zh: E&L 分析技術：AET、GC-MS、HPLC、ICP-AES、ICP-MS、LC-MS、LC-UV、FTIR、IC、MS、NVR — 浸出物鑑定與定量的分析工具鏈
blocks.en: E&L analytical techniques: AET, GC-MS, HPLC, ICP-AES, ICP-MS, LC-MS, LC-UV, FTIR, IC, MS, NVR - the analytical toolchain for leachable identification and quantification

blocks.zh: 一次性系統本體：SUS、SUB、SUT、CCS、PPC、PCM、EPDM、TPE、PE、PP、PET — 設備、材料與組件的識別
blocks.en: Single-use system body: SUS, SUB, SUT, CCS, PPC, PCM, EPDM, TPE, PE, PP, PET - identifying equipment, materials and components

blocks.zh: 毒理學閾值：AET、ADI、TDI、TTC、SCT、QT — E&L 風險評估中的量化決策工具
blocks.en: Toxicological thresholds: AET, ADI, TDI, TTC, SCT, QT - quantitative decision tools in E&L risk assessment

blocks.zh: 法規機構：FDA/CDER、EMA、ICH、EDQM、ISO、BPSA、BPOG、PDA、ELSIE — 多地區法規監管架構
blocks.en: Regulatory bodies: FDA/CDER, EMA, ICH, EDQM, ISO, BPSA, BPOG, PDA, ELSIE - the multi-region regulatory landscape

blocks.zh: 製程與品質：GMP、GLP、CAPA、CPP、QbD、QRM、FMEA、DOE、FAT、SAT、SOP、URS — 製造與品質管理的通用語言
blocks.en: Process and quality: GMP, GLP, CAPA, CPP, QbD, QRM, FMEA, DOE, FAT, SAT, SOP, URS - the common language of manufacturing and quality management

blocks.zh: 重點提示：E&L 閾值層次結構
blocks.en: Key Point: The Hierarchy of E&L Thresholds

blocks.zh: 理解 E&L 閾值的層次關係是 SUT 從業者的核心能力：
blocks.en: Understanding how the E&L thresholds relate to each other is a core skill for SUT practitioners:

blocks.zh: AET（分析評估閾值）：觸發鑑定和定量的最低濃度。低於此值可不報告（但 PAH、MBT、N-亞硝胺除外）
blocks.en: AET (analytical evaluation threshold): the lowest concentration that triggers identification and quantification. Below this value, no reporting is needed (except for PAHs, MBT and N-nitrosamines)

blocks.zh: SCT（安全關注閾值）：低於此值的化合物無須毒理學評估
blocks.en: SCT (safety concern threshold): compounds below this value need no toxicological assessment

blocks.zh: TTC（毒理學關注閾值）：基於 Cramer 分類的毒性潛力評估依據
blocks.en: TTC (threshold of toxicological concern): the basis for assessing toxic potential, based on the Cramer classification

blocks.zh: QT（確認閾值）：需要進行毒理學確認的濃度水準
blocks.en: QT (qualification threshold): the concentration level at which toxicological qualification is required

blocks.zh: ADI/TDI（每日允許/攝取量）：以人體暴露量為基礎的最終安全評估指標
blocks.en: ADI/TDI (acceptable/tolerable daily intake): the final safety assessment metric, based on human exposure

blocks.zh: 把 E&L 縮寫群組想像成空氣品質監測的層次：AET 是「偵測下限」（儀器能否量到），SCT 是「無需行動線」（量到了但無安全疑慮），TTC 是「注意線」（需要更多評估），ADI/TDI 是「安全標準」（不能超過的上限）。在 SUT 的 E&L 評估中，每個閾值都對應不同的後續行動要求。
blocks.en: Think of the E&L abbreviation group as the layers of air quality monitoring: the AET is the "detection limit" (can the instrument measure it?), the SCT is the "no-action line" (it was measured but raises no safety concern), the TTC is the "attention line" (more assessment is needed), and the ADI/TDI is the "safety standard" (an upper limit that must not be exceeded). In an SUT E&L assessment, each threshold corresponds to a different follow-up action requirement.

blocks.zh: 最高頻 SUT 縮寫 — CDMO 現場必備
blocks.en: The Most Frequent SUT Abbreviations: Essential on the CDMO Floor

blocks.zh: 在無菌填充 CDMO 日常工作中，以下縮寫最常出現：
blocks.en: In the day-to-day work of an aseptic fill CDMO, the following abbreviations appear most often:

blocks.zh: SUS/SUB — 一次性系統/一次性生物反應器
blocks.en: SUS/SUB - single-use system / single-use bioreactor

blocks.zh: E&L — 浸出物與滲出物
blocks.en: E&L - extractables and leachables

blocks.zh: AET — 分析評估閾值
blocks.en: AET - analytical evaluation threshold

blocks.zh: BPSA/BPOG — 兩大行業組織
blocks.en: BPSA/BPOG - the two major industry bodies

blocks.zh: COA — 分析證書
blocks.en: COA - certificate of analysis

blocks.zh: URS — 使用者需求規格書
blocks.en: URS - user requirements specification

blocks.zh: FAT/SAT — 工廠/現場驗收測試
blocks.en: FAT/SAT - factory/site acceptance testing

blocks.zh: CAPA — 糾正預防措施
blocks.en: CAPA - corrective and preventive action

blocks.zh: TSE/BSE — 傳播性海綿狀腦病/牛海綿狀腦病
blocks.en: TSE/BSE - transmissible spongiform encephalopathy / bovine spongiform encephalopathy

blocks.zh: SAL — 無菌保證水準
blocks.en: SAL - sterility assurance level

blocks.zh: 7.2 Definitions Part 1（定義 第一部分：Absorption – Genotoxic）
blocks.en: 7.2 Definitions Part 1 (Absorption – Genotoxic)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Extractables vs. Leachables 的根本差異
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Fundamental Difference Between Extractables and Leachables

blocks.zh: E&L 是 SUT 最核心的安全評估議題，兩者的本質區別如下：
blocks.en: E&L is the most central safety assessment topic in SUT, and the essential difference between the two is as follows:

blocks.zh: Extractables（可萃取物）：在人為加強條件下（強溶劑、高溫、長時間）從材料中萃出的化合物。這是材料的固有特性，與實際使用的藥品無關。可類比「潛在威脅清單」
blocks.en: Extractables: compounds extracted from a material under deliberately aggressive conditions (strong solvents, high temperature, long duration). This is an inherent property of the material and has nothing to do with the actual drug product used. Think of it as a "list of potential threats"

blocks.zh: Leachables（浸出物）：在正常或接近正常使用條件下，從材料遷移至藥品或製程流體中的化合物。這是藥品與材料組合的特定結果。可類比「實際發生的威脅」
blocks.en: Leachables: compounds that migrate from a material into the drug product or process fluid under normal or near-normal conditions of use. This is a result specific to the combination of drug product and material. Think of it as the "threats that actually occur"

blocks.zh: 邏輯關係：Extractables 測試用於預測最壞情境，Leachables 測試用於確認實際暴露。先做 E 再做 L，E 的結果指導 L 的監測計劃。
blocks.en: Logical relationship: extractables testing is used to predict the worst case, and leachables testing is used to confirm actual exposure. Do E first and then L; the E results guide the L monitoring plan.

blocks.zh: Closed vs. Functionally Closed Process：SUT 設計的核心概念
blocks.en: Closed vs. Functionally Closed Process: A Core Concept of SUT Design

blocks.zh: Closed Process：產品完全不接觸環境。在 SUT 中，密封的一次性袋子系統是典型例子。需要的無菌隔離措施最少，但對系統完整性要求最高。
blocks.en: Closed process: the product never contacts the environment. In SUT, a sealed single-use bag system is a typical example. It needs the fewest aseptic containment measures but places the highest demands on system integrity.

blocks.zh: Functionally Closed Process：系統可以開放，但在使用前經過適當的清潔/消毒/滅菌處理，在生產期間保持封閉狀態。這是 SUT 中更常見的情境 — 例如生物反應器在接種前是開放的，但在培養過程中保持功能封閉。
blocks.en: Functionally closed process: the system may be open, but is cleaned/sanitized/sterilized appropriately before use and remains closed during production. This is the more common scenario in SUT; for example, a bioreactor is open before inoculation but remains functionally closed during the culture.

blocks.zh: 這兩個定義直接決定了設施房間環境的 GMP 等級要求。
blocks.en: These two definitions directly determine the GMP grade required for the room environment.

blocks.zh: End-User vs. Supplier：責任分界的術語基礎
blocks.en: End-User vs. Supplier: The Terminology Behind the Division of Responsibility

blocks.zh: End-User 的定義在本指引中特別重要，因為它明確了責任分工：End-User 是應用 SUT 的製藥廠商，Supplier 是一次性組件的製造商。本指引大量討論的供應商管理、E&L 測試責任分工、COA 審核等議題，都以這個定義為基礎。
blocks.en: The definition of End-User is especially important in this guide because it makes the division of responsibility explicit: the End-User is the pharmaceutical manufacturer applying SUT, and the Supplier is the manufacturer of the single-use components. Much of what the guide discusses, such as supplier management, the division of E&L testing responsibilities and COA review, rests on this definition.

blocks.zh: 值得注意的是：End-User 可以自行採購單個組件後組裝成一次性系統（即 Build-Your-Own），在這種情況下 End-User 同時扮演 Supplier 的部分角色，E&L 測試責任隨之轉移。
blocks.en: It is worth noting that an End-User may purchase individual components and assemble them into a single-use system itself (that is, build-your-own). In this case the End-User also takes on part of the Supplier's role, and the E&L testing responsibility shifts accordingly.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：AET 的例外條款
blocks.en: Key Point: The AET Exception Clause

blocks.zh: AET 定義中有個重要例外：PAH（多環芳烴）、MBT（巰基苯并噻唑）和 N-亞硝胺 — 這三類化合物無論濃度多低，都必須個別評估，不適用 AET 低於則不報告的原則。原因是這些化合物具有已知的致癌潛力，即使微量暴露也可能有安全疑慮。在撰寫 E&L 測試計劃時，必須明確說明對這三類化合物的專項監測安排。
blocks.en: The AET definition contains an important exception: PAHs (polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons), MBT (mercaptobenzothiazole) and N-nitrosamines. These three classes of compounds must each be assessed individually however low their concentration, and the principle of not reporting below the AET does not apply. The reason is that they have known carcinogenic potential, so even trace exposure may raise a safety concern. When writing an E&L test plan, the specific monitoring arrangements for these three classes must be stated explicitly.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：Bioburden 與 SAL
blocks.en: Analogy: Bioburden and SAL

blocks.zh: Bioburden 是滅菌前物品上的微生物負荷量，就像等待消滅的「敵軍數量」。SAL（無菌保證水準）則是指定任意一件滅菌物品上仍有活微生物殘留的機率上限（通常為 10<sup>-6</sup>，即百萬分之一），就像「作戰成功率的保證」。Bioburden 越低，達到相同 SAL 所需的滅菌劑量越小，對材料的輻射損傷也越小，這是為何供應商管控原料 bioburden 如此重要的根本原因。
blocks.en: Bioburden is the microbial load on an item before sterilization, like the "number of enemy troops" waiting to be eliminated. SAL (sterility assurance level) is the upper limit on the probability that any single sterilized item still carries a viable microorganism (usually 10<sup>-6</sup>, one in a million), like a "guarantee of mission success". The lower the bioburden, the lower the sterilization dose needed to reach the same SAL, and the less radiation damage to the material. This is the fundamental reason why supplier control of raw material bioburden is so important.

blocks.zh: FMEA 在 SUT 風險評估中的應用
blocks.en: FMEA in SUT Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: FMEA 是本指引反覆引用的核心風險工具（Ref.72 亦有詳細文獻）。在 SUT 情境中，FMEA 的典型應用場景包括：
blocks.en: FMEA is the core risk tool cited repeatedly in this guide (Ref. 72 also gives a detailed reference). In an SUT context, typical applications of FMEA include:

blocks.zh: 一次性組件的失效模式分析（洩漏、材料降解、連接失效）
blocks.en: Failure mode analysis of single-use components (leaks, material degradation, connection failure)

blocks.zh: E&L 路徑的系統性識別（哪個組件在哪個製程步驟最可能浸出）
blocks.en: Systematic identification of E&L pathways (which component is most likely to leach at which process step)

blocks.zh: SUS 與不銹鋼系統切換時的風險差距分析（Risk Gap Analysis）
blocks.en: Risk gap analysis when switching between SUS and stainless steel systems

blocks.zh: 7.2 Definitions Part 2（定義 第二部分：Hydrophilic – Parenteral Drug）
blocks.en: 7.2 Definitions Part 2 (Hydrophilic – Parenteral Drug)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Integrity Test 的雙重意義
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Dual Meaning of Integrity Test

blocks.zh: 「完整性測試」在 SUT 語境中有兩個截然不同的對象，必須區分：
blocks.en: "Integrity testing" in the SUT context has two entirely different objects, which must be distinguished:

blocks.zh: 一次性組件完整性：測試袋子、連接件或組件是否有結構洩漏 — 本質上是「有沒有破洞」的測試。這是物理性密封完整性評估。
blocks.en: Single-use component integrity: tests whether a bag, connector or component has a structural leak. In essence this is a "is there a hole?" test, a physical assessment of seal integrity.

blocks.zh: 過濾器完整性：測試過濾器是否能保留指定尺寸的粒子（如氣泡點測試）— 本質上是確認過濾器的孔洞大小是否符合規格。
blocks.en: Filter integrity: tests whether a filter can retain particles of a specified size (such as the bubble point test). In essence this confirms that the filter's pore size meets specification.

blocks.zh: 兩者的測試目的、方法和驗收標準完全不同，在技術文件中使用「完整性測試」時應明確指定對象。
blocks.en: The purpose, method and acceptance criteria of the two are completely different, so when "integrity test" is used in technical documents, the object should be specified explicitly.

blocks.zh: Leachables vs. Migration：術語的微妙差異
blocks.en: Leachables vs. Migration: A Subtle Difference in Terminology

blocks.zh: Leachables 是廣義的定義（遷移至藥品或製程流體中的任何化合物），在藥學領域有高度特定的法規含義，是 E&L 評估的核心術語。
blocks.en: Leachables is the broader definition (any compound that migrates into the drug product or process fluid). It has a highly specific regulatory meaning in the pharmaceutical field and is the core term of E&L assessment.

blocks.zh: Migration 的定義來自歐洲藥典，強調的是在模擬預期使用條件下的釋放，主要用於描述塑膠容器材料的遷移。
blocks.en: Migration is defined in the European Pharmacopoeia and emphasizes release under simulated conditions of intended use; it is mainly used to describe migration from plastic container materials.

blocks.zh: 兩個術語在中文往往都譯為「浸出」或「遷移」，但在法規語境中應注意其原文含義的細微差異。
blocks.en: The two terms are often rendered by the same word in translation ("leaching" or "migration"), but in a regulatory context the subtle difference in the meaning of the original terms should be kept in mind.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Open / Closed / Functionally Closed 的工廠應用
blocks.en: Key Point: Open / Closed / Functionally Closed in Plant Applications

blocks.zh: 在設計無菌製造廠房時，製程分類直接影響廠房等級要求：
blocks.en: When designing an aseptic manufacturing plant, the process classification directly affects the facility grade requirements:

blocks.zh: Open Process：產品暴露於環境中，需要 ISO 5 / Grade A 局部保護環境。典型例子：傳統開放式無菌充填。
blocks.en: Open process: the product is exposed to the environment and needs a local protective environment of ISO 5 / Grade A. Typical example: traditional open aseptic filling.

blocks.zh: Closed Process：完全封閉，可在較低等級環境中操作（例如 ISO 8 / Grade C 背景）。典型例子：密閉式隔離器（Isolator）灌裝。
blocks.en: Closed process: fully closed, and can be operated in a lower-grade environment (for example an ISO 8 / Grade C background). Typical example: closed isolator filling.

blocks.zh: Functionally Closed Process：生物製藥上游製程（培養基配製、生物反應器培養）的典型情境。根據風險評估，可在 Grade C 或 Grade D 環境操作。
blocks.en: Functionally closed process: the typical scenario for biopharmaceutical upstream processing (media preparation, bioreactor culture). Based on risk assessment, it can be operated in a Grade C or Grade D environment.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：Hydrophilic vs. Hydrophobic 在 SUT 材料選擇中
blocks.en: Analogy: Hydrophilic vs. Hydrophobic in SUT Material Selection

blocks.zh: 選擇一次性過濾器時，親水性（Hydrophilic）和疏水性（Hydrophobic）是關鍵選材考量：
blocks.en: When selecting a single-use filter, hydrophilicity and hydrophobicity are key material considerations:

blocks.zh: 親水性過濾器（如 PES、PVDF 親水版）：適用於水溶液過濾，無需預濕，常用於緩衝液和藥液過濾
blocks.en: Hydrophilic filters (such as PES, hydrophilic PVDF): suitable for aqueous filtration, need no pre-wetting, and are commonly used for buffer and drug solution filtration

blocks.zh: 疏水性過濾器（如 PTFE、PVDF 疏水版）：不被水潤濕，適用於氣體除菌過濾（排氣/通氣過濾），以及需要防止水回流的應用
blocks.en: Hydrophobic filters (such as PTFE, hydrophobic PVDF): not wetted by water, suitable for sterilizing-grade gas filtration (vent/air filters) and for applications that need to prevent water backflow

blocks.zh: 材料親疏水性也影響藥物的 Adsorption（蛋白質更容易吸附到疏水表面），這是 SUT 相容性評估的關注點之一。
blocks.en: The hydrophilicity or hydrophobicity of a material also affects drug adsorption (proteins adsorb more readily onto hydrophobic surfaces), which is one of the focus points of SUT compatibility assessment.

blocks.zh: Parenteral Drug 的定義與 SUT 的關聯
blocks.en: The Definition of Parenteral Drug and Its Relevance to SUT

blocks.zh: 「注射劑」的定義明確了 SUT 在製藥中的安全標準為何如此嚴格。注射劑直接進入血管、器官或組織，完全繞過人體的天然屏障（皮膚、胃腸道），因此對任何可能接觸藥品的一次性材料，其安全評估標準遠高於口服製劑。這也是 E&L 評估中注射劑有最嚴格的毒理學閾值要求的根本原因。
blocks.en: The definition of "parenteral drug" makes clear why safety standards for SUT in pharmaceutical manufacturing are so strict. Injectables go directly into blood vessels, organs or tissues and bypass the body's natural barriers (skin, gastrointestinal tract) entirely, so the safety assessment standards for any single-use material that may contact the drug product are far higher than for oral dosage forms. This is also the fundamental reason why injectables carry the strictest toxicological threshold requirements in E&L assessment.

blocks.zh: 如果一次性生物反應器袋在培養過程中被發現有微小洩漏，應採用哪種類型的 Integrity Test 進行根本原因調查？你會選擇哪種測試方法（參照 Refs 112–120）？
blocks.en: If a minor leak is found in a single-use bioreactor bag during culture, which type of integrity test should be used for the root cause investigation? Which test method would you choose (see Refs 112–120)?

blocks.zh: 一個新藥的生物反應器培養製程從傳統不銹鋼切換到 SUS。這個製程是 Closed、Functionally Closed 還是 Open？這個分類如何影響廠房的 GMP 等級設計？
blocks.en: A new drug's bioreactor culture process is switched from conventional stainless steel to SUS. Is this process closed, functionally closed or open? How does this classification affect the GMP grade design of the facility?

blocks.zh: AET 的定義中排除了 PAH、MBT 和 N-亞硝胺。請說明為何這三類化合物需要個別評估，以及在測試計劃中如何特別處理？
blocks.en: The AET definition excludes PAHs, MBT and N-nitrosamines. Explain why these three classes of compounds need individual assessment, and how they should be handled specifically in the test plan.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: SUT 標準體系五大支柱：本附錄 129 項參考文獻橫跨行業組織（BPSA/BPOG）、法規文件（FDA/EU GMP/ICH）、藥典（USP/EP/JP）、國際標準（ISO/ASTM）和 ISPE 指引 — 掌握各類別的法律地位和引用時機是 SUT 從業者的基礎能力
blocks.en: The five pillars of the SUT standards system: the 129 references in this appendix span industry bodies (BPSA/BPOG), regulatory documents (FDA/EU GMP/ICH), pharmacopoeias (USP/EP/JP), international standards (ISO/ASTM) and ISPE guides. Knowing the legal status of each category and when to cite it is a foundational skill for SUT practitioners

blocks.zh: E&L 關鍵概念：Extractables（材料固有特性，強制條件萃取）vs. Leachables（材料與藥品組合的特定結果，正常使用條件遷移）是 SUT 安全評估的核心概念，兩者缺一不可
blocks.en: Key E&L concepts: extractables (an inherent property of the material, extracted under forced conditions) vs. leachables (a result specific to the combination of material and drug product, migrating under normal conditions of use) are the core concepts of SUT safety assessment, and neither can be omitted

blocks.zh: 製程分類的法規影響：Open / Closed / Functionally Closed Process 的分類直接決定廠房環境等級要求，在 CDMO 設計新設施或切換 SUT 時，此分類是 GMP 設計的起點
blocks.en: Regulatory impact of process classification: the classification of open / closed / functionally closed process directly determines the facility environment grade requirements, and is the starting point of GMP design when a CDMO designs a new facility or switches to SUT

blocks.zh: AET 例外條款：PAH、MBT 和 N-亞硝胺三類特殊化合物不適用 AET 篩選規則，必須個別全面評估 — 這是 E&L 測試計劃設計的必要注意事項
blocks.en: The AET exception clause: the three special compound classes PAHs, MBT and N-nitrosamines are not subject to the AET screening rule and must each be fully assessed individually; this is an essential point when designing an E&L test plan

blocks.zh: 供應商管理的條約依據：BPOG/BPSA 變更通知共識文件（Ref.81）和 ASTM E3051（Ref.41）是 SUT 供應商審計和合約談判中最直接相關的標準，應熟悉其核心要求
blocks.en: The contractual basis of supplier management: the BPOG/BPSA change notification consensus document (Ref. 81) and ASTM E3051 (Ref. 41) are the standards most directly relevant to SUT supplier audits and contract negotiation, and their core requirements should be familiar

blocks.zh: 縮寫群組記憶法：按功能分類記憶（分析技術、毒理閾值、組件材料、法規機構、製程品質）比逐條死記更有效。SUT 日常最高頻縮寫：SUS、E&L、AET、BPSA/BPOG、COA、URS、FAT/SAT、SAL
blocks.en: Memorizing abbreviations by group: memorizing by function (analytical techniques, toxicological thresholds, component materials, regulatory bodies, process and quality) is more effective than rote memorization one by one. The most frequent SUT abbreviations in daily work: SUS, E&L, AET, BPSA/BPOG, COA, URS, FAT/SAT, SAL

blocks.zh: Integrity Test 雙重意義：一次性組件的物理完整性測試（有無洩漏）和過濾器的功能完整性測試（孔徑是否符合規格）方法完全不同，在技術文件中必須明確區分對象
blocks.en: The dual meaning of integrity test: physical integrity testing of single-use components (leak or no leak) and functional integrity testing of filters (whether pore size meets specification) use completely different methods, and the object must be specified explicitly in technical documents
